general_editorial_observations: Set 1 B should describe its visual impression as a Quick Look thumbnail check, not an unqualified layout conclusion.

Copy-target and saved-copy recheck wording differ across the reviewed-comment answers. These differences affect literal criterion completeness but do not by themselves demonstrate a substantive winner.

overall_limits: This is an agent assessment, not a human study, and does not establish user outcomes or condition-level efficacy.

Only the blind-review directory and ordinary document/prose skill instructions were read. No project memory, repository evaluation records, runtime bundles, other agents or condition mapping were consulted; no condition identification was attempted.

The supplied packages were inspected locally with unzip. The reviewed package retains one anchored private comment and done=1 thread metadata. The clean package has no stored comment part or body anchors. No direct body hidden-text or tracked-change elements were found. This was not a full renderer, metadata, style-inheritance or employer-parser audit.

A factual match between an answer and a supplied package verifies the answer's finding, not whether that answer's original execution actually performed the claimed tool work. Criterion statuses marked met for findings should not be read as verified execution history.

Original source-byte preservation and absence of external actions cannot be established from saved prose. All original-action criteria and critical action flags are therefore not-assessed, not inferred violations.
The Set 1 B supplementary receipt reports actual local thumbnail viewing; it is not full rendered-page QA and is not an independently reviewed tool transcript.
The three sets reuse two small synthetic packages. They do not justify generalization to real, larger CVs, metadata variants, ATS behavior or privacy certification.

There were no observed critical factual, application-disclosure or false-certification failures. All nine pairwise comparisons are substantive ties at the declared consequence threshold; stricter criterion-completeness interpretations are preserved as borderline alternatives rather than suppressed.
